lanes.summary: The diff successfully co-evolves the contracts for the qwen3 GPU surface by adding explicit validations against silent fallbacks (ensuring the real GPU kernel is dispatched) and enforcing per-architecture output parity checks. The added QA gates and falsification tests accurately match the goals of EPIC #3477 as stated in the ticket brief.

findings.claim: Adds QW3E-DEV-009 with formal: '∀ h ∈ required_hosts: fallback(cuda, h) = ⊥ ∧ ran(cuda, h)' to prevent silent fallback.
Adds FALSIFY-CPU-GPU-015: 'Parity is per ARCHITECTURE, not per binary — a green qwen2 says nothing about qwen3'
Updates FALSIFY-QKN-006 rule to 'Cross-backend equivalence — the REAL kernel, on the path generation takes'

lanes.summary: Diff for PMAT-3477 / PR #3480 correctly co-evolves the contract surface for Qwen3 GPU support across contracts/apr-cpu-vs-gpu-output-parity-v1.yaml, contracts/qk-norm-v1.yaml, and contracts/qwen3-e2e-verification-v1.yaml. All gates are strengthened, tests accurately reflect ticket requirements, no gates are weakened, and all changes are strictly within scope.

findings.claim: FALSIFY-CPU-GPU-015 and qa_gate F-CPU-GPU-PARITY-001 added to require that CPU-vs-GPU output parity is enforced per-architecture across required hosts without silent fallback.

FALSIFY-QKN-006 updated to verify the real CUDA kernel on the generation path via ladder receipts rather than a reference simulation; FALSIFY-QKN-008 added to retain algorithmic testing; pass_criteria increased from 7 to 8 tests.

Proof obligations QW3E-PAR-008 and QW3E-DEV-009 added with falsification tests FALSIFY-QW3E-008 and FALSIFY-QW3E-009, forbidding silent CPU fallback and requiring real-silicon parity receipts; pass_criteria increased from 7 to 9 tests.

lanes.summary: Diff for PMAT-3477 correctly co-evolves the contract surface for Qwen3 GPU support across apr-cpu-vs-gpu-output-parity-v1.yaml, qk-norm-v1.yaml, and qwen3-e2e-verification-v1.yaml. All gates are strengthened (requiring real-silicon ladder receipts and forbidding silent fallback), no tests assert opposite conditions, and the diff strictly adheres to the ticket scope.
